hook: Make AI videos on your own PC, no credits.
hookText: Free local AI video, 8 GB VRAM

beats.say: FreeVideo is an open-source, Apache 2.0 desktop app for Windows, Mac and Linux that generates AI videos on your own GPU.
It runs MiniMax H3 video generation in as little as eight gigabytes of video memory, with no subscription and no credits.
It takes text, image, video and audio inputs, makes videos up to a minute long, and has a built-in timeline editor, plus H3 images up to sixteen megapixels.
